description: Append the next base64 chunk to a chunked upload started with begin_generated_media_upload. Send chunks in order with seq starting at 0, at most 8000 base64 characters each; if a call returns a 409 conflict, resume from the expectedSeq in the error details. Intended for files generated in this conversation (charts, cards, edited images); user-attached files and files on the user's device are handled by attach_media (the in-chat upload widget, full quality). Chunks are limited to 8000 base64 characters because larger payloads are silently truncated by the chat channel.

data.description: The next base64 chunk, at most 8000 characters.

seq.description: 0-based chunk index. Must match the next expected sequence (starts at 0).

name: append_generated_media_chunk
title: Append Generated Media Chunk
